_comment: 32a (Siemens star, 30 keV, parallel beam + objective-FZP scan). Positions in um: FZP X x 2.5 um, FZP Y x 0.2 um (see report: 0.2 um makes the scan rings circular). Lens shift d -> pupil shift d/(lambda p): 'czp_focal_m' is used as p (=0.75 m, not measured) with stage_step_um = 1 (positions in um). Input = d32a/data_reg (dark offset 100 subtracted, stage-rounding shifts corrected), so dark_offset = 0. Rings 0-3 (90 images).
